test_plan.scope: Validate FR-039..FR-047 (eval tick alignment, rule schema, condition language, verdict lifecycle, SSE delivery, dashboard rendering, persistence, hysteresis, bootstrap rule set) plus NFR-016..NFR-021 (performance budget, persistence reuse, observability, security/no-runtime-rules, UX tokens, notify isolation).
test_plan.approach: Three-layer pyramid. Unit tests pin pure logic (lang parser/compiler, comparison/sustained operators, rule schema decoder). Integration tests exercise the engine + store + SSE broker with an injected clock and a fake metrics snapshot. e2e tests run the real HTTP handlers (GET /api/insights/verdicts) and the SSE event encoder against an in-process server with seeded DB. Browser-based accessibility / DOM rendering tests are deferred to manual exclusions and substituted with HTTP-level fragment tests in implementation.
fixtures: fakeMetricsSnapshot — deterministic *metrics.Snapshot builder with knobs for cpu_pct, ram_pct, swap_pct, temp_c, disk_pct[partition], wan_gateway_ok, wan_cloudflare_ok, wan_packet_loss_pct, lan_device_offline_count, container_unhealthy[name], service_failed[name]; supports per-tick overrides for sustained-window TCs
injectedClock — deterministic clock (now + advance(d)) used everywhere instead of time.Now; sustained windows and flap windows are driven by it
tmpDB — t.TempDir() SQLite per test, full parent schema + insights tables (rules, rule_state)
bundledRulesYAML — the go:embed bundled.json fixture (10 rules) loaded from internal/insights/rules; test variants override via insights/rules.LoadFromBytes(...) for negative cases
fakeSSEBroker — in-memory broker that records (event, payload) pairs per Eval call so tests can assert verdicts events without spinning real HTTP
authTestSession — helper that issues a valid session cookie against the parent authMiddleware for e2e API tests
exclusions: No headless-browser DOM tests for FR-044 dashboard rendering — declared as manual / e2e-deferred technical debt. Substituted with HTTP-level tests against the rendered HTMX fragment (sse-verdicts.html) asserting sort order, escaping, and empty state via goquery on the response body. Browser-driven accessibility (axe-core) checks are postponed to a later milestone.

No live-network or real-Pi performance tests for NFR-016. Performance TCs use injectedClock + counters + testing.AllocsPerRun, never wall-clock, to keep CI deterministic. The 24 h soak / 1 h idle FP runs in NFR-016 / FR-047 AC-001 are validated via synthetic ticks driven by the injected clock, not real time.

No tests for the parent FR-001 metrics tick itself, FR-013 SSE plumbing, FR-007 auth middleware, or FR-015 backup mechanics — covered by parent-feature tests; this feature only verifies its consumers.

No tests for v2 features explicitly excluded by no-go-zone: rule-authoring UI, push notifications from verdicts, verdict history, cross-host correlation, ML/anomaly detection, runtime rule loading — these have no v1 surface to test.

test_cases.title: Engine evaluates all enabled rules on each metrics tick and publishes a verdict-set before the next tick
preconditions: engine.Start(ctx, tmpDB, fakeCollector) succeeds with the bundled rule set loaded
fakeSSEBroker registered as the verdict sink
test_cases.given: Engine running with the bundled 10-rule set; fakeMetricsSnapshot returning cpu_pct=10, temp_c=45, all probes ok
test_cases.when: The metrics tick fires once (broker calls engine.Eval(snapshot))
test_cases.then: Exactly one 'verdicts' event is recorded by fakeSSEBroker for that tick; the event's verdict slice is empty (idle Pi, no rules trigger); engine reports lastEvalAt == tick T
steps: Construct fakeMetricsSnapshot for an idle Pi
Call engine.Eval(snapshot) once via the broker hook
Assert fakeSSEBroker.Events('verdicts') has length 1 and payload verdict slice is empty
Assert engine.LastEvalAt() == injectedClock.Now()
test_cases.expected_result: 1 verdicts event emitted; verdict slice empty; LastEvalAt advanced to current tick

test_cases.title: Snapshot unavailable for a tick — no new verdict-set emitted, previous set held, single 'snapshot-missing' log
preconditions: Engine has previously emitted a verdict-set with N≥1 active verdicts on tick T-1
test_cases.given: Engine running; fakeCollector returns (nil, ErrSnapshotUnavailable) for tick T
test_cases.when: The broker's tick fires and engine.Eval is invoked with a nil/empty snapshot
test_cases.then: No new 'verdicts' event is appended for tick T; the previously published verdict set is held (broker reuses last payload); exactly one structured log line 'snapshot-missing' is emitted
steps: Drive tick T-1 with a fakeMetricsSnapshot that fires 1 verdict
Configure fakeCollector to return ErrSnapshotUnavailable for tick T
Drive tick T
Assert fakeSSEBroker received no new 'verdicts' event (event count unchanged)
Assert log capture contains exactly 1 entry with key='snapshot-missing'
test_cases.expected_result: No new verdicts event for tick T; log count('snapshot-missing') == 1; previous verdict slice unchanged

test_cases.title: 100 evaluation ticks against the bundled rule set complete within total budget (synthetic perf, NFR-016)
preconditions: Engine started with the full bundled rule set
injectedClock advances 5 s per logical tick
test_cases.given: Engine + bundled 10 rules; fakeMetricsSnapshot returning a steady mid-load profile (cpu=45, temp=55, all probes ok)
test_cases.when: 100 sequential engine.Eval(snapshot) calls are issued and per-call wall-clock duration is measured via Go's testing benchmarking surface (not injected clock — we measure the engine code itself)
test_cases.then: Total CPU time across 100 ticks is < 500 ms (i.e. p99-equivalent ceiling of 5 ms/tick budget per NFR-016 design table); per-tick allocations are zero after the warm-up tick

Capture testing.AllocsPerRun(100, func(){ engine.Eval(snapshot) })
Measure total wall-clock over 100 Eval calls
Assert total < 500 ms and AllocsPerRun == 0
test_cases.expected_result: Total 100-tick duration < 500 ms; testing.AllocsPerRun == 0; no panics, no rule disabled

test_cases.when: GET /api/insights/verdicts with Accept: application/json and no auth cookie
test_cases.then: Status 401; response body matches the parent auth-error contract (e.g. {"error":"unauthenticated"}); body does NOT contain the verdict's title, verdict_text, recommendation, or rule_id
steps: Issue GET with no cookie
Assert status == 401
Assert response body shape matches parent contract
Assert response body does not contain the active verdict's title or rule_id substrings
test_cases.expected_result: Status 401; no verdict fields leaked in body; matches parent FR-007 auth-error contract

test_cases.title: Two rules sharing an id: the first loads, the second is rejected as duplicate-rule-id
preconditions: rules.LoadFromBytes reachable with a capturing LogFunc
test_cases.given: A rule document with two well-formed entries that both declare id 'same_id', differing in title, condition and severity
test_cases.when: LoadFromBytes decodes the document
test_cases.then: Load succeeds; exactly one rule is returned; it is the FIRST occurrence (title 'First', severity critical); the log names 'same_id' with reason duplicate-rule-id
steps: Build a two-entry document sharing one id
Call LoadFromBytes with a capturing logger
Assert one rule survives and it is the first occurrence
Assert the log carries duplicate-rule-id and the offending id
test_cases.expected_result: len(rules)==1, rules[0].Title=='First', rules[0].Severity=='critical', log contains duplicate-rule-id and same_id

test_cases.title: A rule over an absent variable resolves false and logs skipped-missing-var once per process
preconditions: Engine started with the bundled rule set and an injected clock
test_cases.given: An otherwise idle snapshot with 'lan_device_offline_count' deleted from the variable map, as when the lan-devices feature is disabled (the AC calls this variable 'lan_device_count'; the shipped rule and buildEvalCtx name it lan_device_offline_count)
test_cases.when: Five consecutive ticks are evaluated
test_cases.then: lan_offline_burst never fires; the active set stays empty; exactly one 'skipped-missing-var' line naming the variable is emitted across all five ticks
steps: Delete lan_device_offline_count from idleVars
Evaluate 5 ticks 5s apart
Assert lan_offline_burst never appears in any verdict slice
Assert Active() is empty
Assert exactly 1 skipped-missing-var line naming the variable
test_cases.expected_result: No verdict from lan_offline_burst; Active() empty; exactly 1 skipped-missing-var log line

test_cases.title: Within one severity, verdicts are ordered by first_emitted_at descending (newest first)
preconditions: Engine started with the bundled rule set and an injected clock
test_cases.given: wan_lan_disambig (warn) fires at T0; one minute later memory_pressure (warn) also fires, so two verdicts share a severity and differ only in first_emitted_at
test_cases.when: Active() is read repeatedly (20 times — Active() iterates a map, so a dropped tie-break would still order correctly about half the time on a single read)
test_cases.then: On every read the newer verdict (memory_pressure) is first and its FirstEmittedAt is strictly after the older one's
steps: Fire wan_lan_disambig at T0
Advance 1 minute and fire memory_pressure
Read Active() 20 times
Assert memory_pressure is index 0 on every read
Assert FirstEmittedAt[0] is after FirstEmittedAt[1]
test_cases.expected_result: memory_pressure sorts ahead of wan_lan_disambig on all 20 reads; ordering is FirstEmittedAt descending

test_cases.title: An orphan RuleState row survives, does not fail startup, and is ignored at evaluation
preconditions: Engine bound to a fresh database with an injected clock
test_cases.given: A RuleState row persisted for 'rule_removed_in_a_later_build', a rule id absent from bundled.json
test_cases.when: LoadBundled runs over that database and a tick is evaluated
test_cases.then: Startup succeeds; the orphan never yields a verdict nor enters the active set; a real rule (disk_critical) still fires normally; the orphan row remains on disk rather than being silently deleted
steps: PersistState for a rule id not in bundled.json
Call LoadBundled and assert no error
Evaluate an idle tick and assert the orphan produces no verdict
Drive disk_root_pct to 99 and assert disk_critical still fires
Reload state and assert the orphan row is still present
test_cases.expected_result: LoadBundled returns nil; no verdict carries the orphan id; disk_critical fires; the orphan row survives in the store

test_cases.title: The rule-flapping line is emitted once per window and carries rule_id and transition_count
preconditions: Engine started with the bundled rule set, FlapThreshold at its default of 5
test_cases.given: disk_root_pct flipped 98/20 once per second for six ticks, so disk_critical transitions repeatedly inside the hysteresis window
test_cases.when: The hold engages
test_cases.then: Exactly one rule-flapping line mentions disk_critical, and that line carries the rule_id field, the transition_count field, and the count 5 — the threshold crossing that engaged the hold
steps: Evaluate one idle tick
Flip disk_root_pct between 98 and 20 across six 1s ticks
Assert exactly one rule-flapping line names disk_critical
Assert that line carries rule_id and transition_count
Assert the reported count is 5
test_cases.expected_result: 1 rule-flapping line for disk_critical, carrying rule_id, transition_count and the value 5

test_cases.title: wan_gateway_ok true with wan_cloudflare_ok false over two consecutive ticks yields the WAN/LAN verdict at warn
preconditions: Engine started with the bundled rule set and an injected clock
test_cases.given: An otherwise idle snapshot with wan_gateway_ok=1 and wan_cloudflare_ok=0 held constant
test_cases.when: Two consecutive ticks are evaluated five seconds apart
test_cases.then: The wan_lan_disambig verdict is present after each tick (it holds rather than flickers); its severity is warn; its text points at the public internet rather than the LAN
steps: Set wan_gateway_ok=1 and wan_cloudflare_ok=0
Evaluate tick 1 and assert the verdict is active
Advance 5s, evaluate tick 2 and assert it is still active
Assert severity == warn
Assert the verdict text mentions the internet
test_cases.expected_result: wan_lan_disambig active on both ticks with severity warn and internet-facing verdict text
